decisions.reason: GA4 is the mandatory analytics standard, so the plugin has steady demand from shop clients, costs little to maintain, and its value is confirmed rather than uncertain.
The retail system interface plugin remains a cheap option that fits the firm's integration expertise, and nothing so far shows its value won't be realized, so it stays open.
Relaunch SEO support directly complements the firm's core relaunch projects, is presented on its own page, and costs little to offer.
The SEO workshops were launched only recently and their prospects are still uncertain, but they draw on existing marketing expertise at low cost, so keeping the option open is sensible.
